data.name: Macrophage polarization
data.description: The M1/M2 phenotypic switch in macrophages, an immunometabolic decision governed substantially by PI3K/AKT/mTOR signalling.
data.description_beginner: Macrophages are immune cells that can take on opposite jobs: attacking invaders (M1) or cleaning up and repairing tissue (M2). Which one they become depends heavily on how they burn fuel, and PI3K/AKT/mTOR signalling is a main controller of that choice.
